title: Performance Marketing Manager (m/f/x) - Mid Level
description_clean:

Als digitaler Growth Partner unterstützen wir Unternehmen dabei, Wachstum messbar, effizient und nachhaltig voranzutreiben. In deiner Rolle verbindest du strategisches Denken mit operativer Exzellenz und arbeitest eng mit unseren Teams aus Performance, Creative, Tech und Strategie zusammen.
Aufgaben
Performance-Strategie & Wachstum

Gemeinsam mit dem Projektteam entwickelst du passende Wachstums- und Performance-Marketing-Strategien für unsere Kunden.
Du übersetzt Geschäftsziele in konkrete Kanal-, Kampagnen- und Budgetstrategien über relevante Online-Marketing-Kanäle hinweg, darunter Paid Search, Paid Social, Display, Native und Programmatic.
Du steuerst Budgets kanal- und zielgruppenübergreifend und sorgst dafür, dass Maßnahmen effizient auf die definierten Wachstumsziele einzahlen.
Du analysierst laufend Performance-Daten, leitest konkrete Optimierungsmaßnahmen ab und passt Strategien regelmäßig an.
Du nutzt moderne AI-Tools wie ChatGPT, Claude und weitere Anwendungen, um Analysen, Recherchen, Kampagnenkonzepte, Reportings und operative Prozesse effizienter und wirkungsvoller zu gestalten.

Kampagnensteuerung & Marketing Operations

Du verantwortest das Setup, Management und die kontinuierliche Optimierung von Performance-Marketing-Kampagnen.
Du etablierst Reporting- und Controlling-Prozesse, überwachst relevante KPIs und behältst Budgets, Timings und Ergebnisse im Blick.
Du übersetzt Kundenziele in klare Aufgaben für das Performance-Team und gibst strukturierte Briefings.
Du bist Impulsgeber für aktuelle Performance-Marketing-Themen, neue Tools und AI-basierte Arbeitsweisen und teilst dein Wissen aktiv im Team.

Kunden, Stakeholder & Zusammenarbeit

In Kundenterminen und Jour Fixes präsentierst du Performance-Strategien, Maßnahmen und Ergebnisse verständlich und überzeugend.
Du stellst sicher, dass Kunden Anforderungen, nächste Schritte und Performance-Hebel jederzeit nachvollziehen können.
Du erkennst Potenziale, bringst eigene Ideen ein und entwickelst gemeinsam mit dem Projektteam konkrete Maßnahmen zur Zielerreichung.
Du arbeitest eng mit unserem Creative Team zusammen, um datenbasierte kreative Konzepte, neue Testansätze und wirkungsvolle Kampagnenideen zu entwickeln.

Qualifikation

Du hast mindestens 3–5 Jahre Erfahrung im Performance Marketing gesammelt, idealerweise im Agentur-, E-Commerce-, B2C- oder B2B-Umfeld.
Du kennst dich in mehreren Online-Marketing-Kanälen gut aus, zum Beispiel Paid Social, Paid Search, Native oder Programmatic, und hast in mindestens einem Kanal echte Expertentiefe.
Du hast Erfahrung mit Tracking, Reporting und KPI-basierter Kampagnensteuerung.
Du triffst Entscheidungen datenbasiert und verbindest analytisches Denken mit pragmatischer Umsetzung.
Du bist neugierig auf neue Technologien und hast idealerweise bereits Erfahrung im Umgang mit AI-Tools wie ChatGPT, Claude oder vergleichbaren Anwendungen.
Du verfolgst Performance-Marketing-Trends aktiv und bringst neue Impulse proaktiv ins Team ein.
Du managst deine Projekte proaktiv und selbstständig, findest dich aber auch schnell in Teams ein und schätzt Kollaboration und gute Zusammenarbeit.
Du arbeitest analytisch, detailorientiert und strukturiert.
Du kommunizierst sicher auf Deutsch und Englisch.

Benefits

Echte Verantwortung ab Tag 1: Du übernimmst eigene Projekte und gestaltest Wachstumsstrategien aktiv mit.
Interdisziplinäres Expertenteam: Du arbeitest mit erfahrenen Kollegen aus Performance, Creative, Tech und Strategie zusammen.
Moderne Ausstattung: Technisch aktuelles Work Equipment ist für uns selbstverständlich. (MacBook)
Mobilität: BVG-Zuschuss oder Swapfiets-Abo. Du kannst entscheiden
Erholung: Wer neue Wege geht, braucht hin und wieder eine Pause. Deshalb bekommst du bei uns 28 Urlaubstage im Jahr.
Weiterentwicklung: Eigene Projektverantwortung, große Handlungsfreiheit und der Erfahrungs- und Wissensschatz unseres Teams sorgen dafür, dass du dich fachlich und persönlich weiterentwickeln kannst. Desweiteren wirst du regelmäßig an Fortbildungsveranstaltungen teilnehmen, um in der Online Marketing Welt immer auf dem neusten Stand zu bleiben.
AI-enabled Workflows: Wir arbeiten aktiv mit modernen Tools und Technologien, um bessere Ergebnisse für unsere Kunden zu erzielen und unsere Prozesse kontinuierlich weiterzuentwickeln.
Teamkultur: Erfolge zu feiern und als Team zusammenzukommen ist uns wichtig. Deshalb schaffen wir regelmäßig Raum für Austausch, Lernen und gemeinsame Teamevents.

title: Partnerships Manager (all genders) B2B SaaS for KMU
description_clean:
German SMEs carry an unavoidable administrative load: bookkeeping, monthly VAT returns, annual accounts. Work that must happen, that nobody wants to do, and that has stayed far too expensive.
mika takes it over. Because compliance is mandatory rather than optional, what we are building is infrastructure, and the purpose is to reduce the cost of doing business in Germany.
We went from 100 to over 700 customers in eight months and remain a small team. Roles here are therefore wide: you own an area rather than a slice of one, there is more to build than there are people to build it, and your scope grows as you do. We work in English, the team is international, the market is German.
Tasks
Partner and referral leads arrive already trusting us, which is the hardest part of our sale to manufacture any other way. We have only recently started testing this properly and it is already carrying a meaningful share of new pipeline. The pieces exist and nobody holds them together.
Networker and closer, in one person. Partnerships attracts people who are wonderful in a room, know everybody, and never sign anything. It also attracts people who can close but cannot keep a relationship alive past the signature. We need both halves.
And we need somebody who knows that a partnership is more than paying someone to send us customers. The ones that last are built on something both sides actually want: a better answer for their own customers, a gap in their offering closed, a reason for them to look good. If your instinct is to open with a commission rate, this is not the role.
You build the channel across referral and integration partners and the programmes around them, and you shape where it goes beyond that. We will talk about the specifics in the process.
what you will do

Own the channel and its number end to end
Close. Take partnerships from first conversation to signed agreement, including the commercial negotiation.
Structure the deals yourself. Work out what the partner gets, at which price tier, on the subscription or on the one-off revenue or both, over what period. You should know our unit economics well enough to say no without asking.
Own what happens after signature: technical handover, partner onboarding, and the routing rule agreed with the sales lead
Own the affiliate programme and our comparison-page strategy, working with our creative lead on production
Own our presence at events and conferences, where a surprising share of partnerships actually start
Prepare joint marketing with existing partners: webinars, co-branded content, campaigns
Apply our values filter honestly. Not every partner who would send us volume is one we want, and we would rather you turned one down than explained it afterwards.

Requirements
what you bring to the table

AI-native, not AI-curious. Claude or an equivalent is your daily sparring partner rather than a tool you open occasionally. You augment your own output with it and you automate the parts of your job that should not need a human.
You have closed partnership deals yourself, negotiated the terms, and can name what they produced afterwards
Ideally a real network in the German SME and entrepreneurship world, or in fintech.
You are commercially fluent. Revenue share, referral fees, attribution windows, exclusivity, minimum commitments: you model a deal and defend the structure.
You understand a business well enough to build the case from the partner's side rather than pitching at them
You follow up relentlessly and you keep partners warm after launch, which is where most partnerships quietly die
You are organised enough to run many parallel conversations without letting any of them go cold

the level we are hiring at
If you have been the second person in a function somewhere good and this is your step up, that is the profile we want. We have a strong bias towards people who have been entrepreneurs themselves. As the team grows, the path from here leads to Head of Partnerships.
We keep the team small by giving people leverage instead of headcount. That is why the AI point above is a requirement rather than a preference, and it is what lets one person hold more live conversations at once than this job would otherwise allow.
nice to have

German fintech or banking ecosystem
Platform and marketplace partnerships
Comfortable in a technical scoping conversation, enough to know what is easy and what is not
Affiliate and influencer programmes
API integrations and partner onboarding flows
Event and conference experience

German at C1 or above is preferred. The ecosystem we are building in is German and so are most of the negotiations. For an exceptional candidate we would work with English alone, so if the rest fits, apply anyway. English at B2 or above in either case, since it is our working language.
Benefits
Base 60,000 to 80,000 EUR depending on experience, plus a variable component tied to activated partners and partner-sourced revenue rather than to pipeline volume, plus stock options. On-target earnings 75,000 to 100,000 EUR.
Three rounds: an intro conversation, a working session with a short case, and a final round with the founders. Depending on seniority there is an optional fourth conversation with one of our investors or mentors. One meeting happens in person in Berlin, and you hear back within a week at every stage, including if the answer is no.
why mika?

A channel with no incumbent owner, so its shape is your call.
Room, and the expectation that you use it. We hire people who do not need managing and then give them space to grow into more than the job they were hired for.
Deals you structure yourself, rather than terms handed to you
Founders in the detail with you, and no layer between you and a decision
A category nobody has built. German business owners do not know an alternative to their tax advisor exists, which is also why the right partner is worth so much to us.
Work that matters outside the building. Every customer a partner sends us gets back time and money that was disappearing into paperwork.

Send us your CV and one partnership you closed: how the deal was structured, what it produced, and what nearly killed it.
At mika, we value diversity and strive to create an inclusive environment where all employees can thrive. Join us in building the future of small business finance!

title: Consultant Decision Intelligence (m/w/d)
description_clean:
Du entscheidest mit dem CFO, welche fünfzehn Kennzahlen sein Unternehmen künftig steuern.
Montag: Kick-off bei einem Maschinenbauer mit 400 Mitarbeitenden. Auf dem Tisch liegen DATEV, ein ERP, ein CRM, eine Zeiterfassung — und die Frage, warum die Geschäftsführung sechs Wochen nach Monatsende noch keine belastbare Deckungsbeitragsrechnung hat. Freitag: eine priorisierte Liste von Use Cases, eine Roadmap in Wellen, die ersten Kennzahlendefinitionen abgestimmt.
In anderen Tech-Unternehmen heißt dieselbe Arbeit Deployment Strategist, Value Engineer oder Client Value Partner.
ValueWorks ist eine Decision-Intelligence-Plattform für Geschäftsführungen, CFOs und Private-Equity-Investoren im deutschsprachigen Raum. Wir verbinden die Daten aus den Systemen, die unsere Kunden ohnehin haben, in einem semantischen Layer zu einem konsistenten Bild des Unternehmens — und machen daraus Steuerung: Reporting, Diagnose, Planung, OKR. Vier bis acht Wochen bis zum ersten Dashboard.
Gegründet wurde ValueWorks von einem Team aus McKinsey, Bain und SAP — mit entsprechend viel Erfahrung darin, wie Unternehmen tatsächlich gesteuert werden und woran Steuerung in der Praxis scheitert.
Aufgaben
Kick-off und Zielbild: Du moderierst den Kick-off-Workshop — Geschäftsmodell, Systemlandschaft über zehn Prozessbereiche, Pain Points der Führungsmannschaft.
Use Cases ableiten und priorisieren: Aus der Systemlandschaft entwickelst du, was für diesen Kunden möglich und wertvoll ist — von der P&L-Restrukturierung über Pipeline-Forecasts bis zur Churn-Prognose aus CRM-, Support- und Produktdaten. Priorisierung nach Wichtigkeit und Umsetzbarkeit, daraus schneidest du die Umsetzungswellen.
Kennzahlen definieren: Du bringst Finance und Fachbereich zu einer gemeinsamen Definition von „Auftragseingang" oder „DSO" und übersetzt sie so, dass sie im semantischen Layer eindeutig umsetzbar ist. Der anspruchsvollste und wertvollste Teil der Arbeit.
Umsetzung begleiten: Du arbeitest mit unseren Forward Deployed Engineers, die Pipelines und Datenprodukte bauen — du bringst die fachliche Logik, sie die technische Umsetzung. Du validierst die Ergebnisse vor der Übergabe.
Mehrere Mandate parallel führen: Du betreust typischerweise mehrere Kundenprojekte gleichzeitig — jedes mit eigenem Takt, eigenen Stakeholdern und eigener Wellenplanung. Sauber priorisieren, Zusagen halten und nach beiden Seiten klar kommunizieren ist in dieser Rolle genauso entscheidend wie analytische Schärfe.
Wirkung sichern und das Mandat weiterentwickeln: Wöchentlicher Jour Fixe, Wave Reviews, Quarterly Business Reviews mit der Geschäftsführung. Du siehst, ob deine Dashboards Entscheidungen verändern — und wenn sie es tun, wächst die Zusammenarbeit: Kunden verlängern und nehmen weitere Bereiche dazu. Daran misst sich der Erfolg dieser Rolle.
Was diese Rolle nicht ist: kein Ticket-Support, keine Hotline, keine Service-SLAs. Keine Neukunden- oder Kaltakquise — die Kundenbeziehungen, die du führst, bestehen bereits. Und kein Projektmanagement ohne fachlichen Inhalt: du entscheidest inhaltlich mit, nicht nur über Termine.
Qualifikation
Studium in Wirtschaftsinformatik, Information Systems, Wirtschaftsingenieurwesen, BWL mit digitalem Schwerpunkt
Für den Einstieg: erste Praxis aus Praktikum, Werkstudium oder Abschlussarbeit in Controlling, BI, Data Analytics oder Beratung. Wir bilden dich entlang echter Kundenprojekte aus.
Mit 0–3 Jahren Erfahrung: du hast Daten- oder Controlling-Projekte bereits eigenständig verantwortet und führst einen Kick-off nach kurzer Einarbeitung allein.
SQL sicher oder die Bereitschaft, es in den ersten Wochen zu lernen. Du baust keine Pipelines, aber du verstehst, was in ihnen passiert.
Grundverständnis von GuV, Bilanz, Cashflow und Deckungsbeitrag
Du steuerst mehrere Projekte parallel, ohne Überblick oder Zusagen zu verlieren — Projektmanagement ist hier kein Nebenaspekt der Rolle, sondern die Hälfte davon
Kommunikationsstärke: Du erklärst ein Datenmodell einem CFO und eine betriebswirtschaftliche Logik einem Data Engineer — und bewegst dich in beiden Gesprächen sicher
Deutsch verhandlungssicher, Englisch fließend
Benefits
Fachliche Tiefe wie in der Beratung, ohne Montagsflug: C-Level-Kontakt ab dem ersten Projekt, Reisen nach Bedarf statt nach Kalender.
Fixgehalt statt Beteiligungsversprechen: Wir zahlen im oberen Marktbereich und schreiben die Spanne offen in die Anzeige. Kein Equity-Versprechen, auf dessen Wert du jahrelang warten musst — das erste Jahr ist reines Fixum.
Ein klarer Entwicklungspfad, der sich auch im Gehalt zeigt: strukturierte Einarbeitung entlang echter Projekte, nach etwa 12–18 Monaten eigene Kundenprojekte in deiner Verantwortung. Ab dem zweiten Jahr kommt zum Fixum ein variabler Anteil, der sich an den von dir verantworteten Kundenprojekten bemisst — an ihrer Zahl, ihrem Umfang und daran, wie sie sich entwickeln. Danach Spezialisierung (z. B. Financial Analytics, SaaS-Metriken) oder der Weg Richtung Teamverantwortung.
Ergebnisse statt Folien: Was du definierst, geht in ein System und wird benutzt.
Mustererkennung über Branchen: Innerhalb eines Jahres siehst du Systemlandschaft und Steuerungslogik von einem Dutzend Unternehmen — SaaS, Maschinenbau, Handel, PE-Portfolios.
Gründer aus McKinsey, Bain und SAP: Du lernst bei Leuten, die Steuerung und Enterprise-Software von beiden Seiten kennen — kurze Wege, direktes Feedback.
Unser Prozess: 30 Minuten Kennenlernen → Fachgespräch mit einem Kollegen anhand eines echten, anonymisierten Falls → Case-Gespräch mit einem Gründer → Angebot, in der Regel binnen zwei Wochen.
Kein Motivationsschreiben nötig. Schick uns deinen Lebenslauf und zwei Sätze dazu, welcher Teil dieser Beschreibung dich am meisten interessiert.

title: Brand & Communications Lead  (all genders) B2B SaaS for KMU
description_clean:
Small and medium businesses are the backbone of the German economy, and a painful share of their time and cash disappears into compliance. Bookkeeping, VAT returns, annual accounts. Mandatory, joyless, overpriced.
We are building the infrastructure that changes it. Since none of this work is optional, it is closer to infrastructure than to software, and our reason to do it is to lower the cost of doing business in Germany.
Eight months took us from 100 to more than 700 customers, and we are still small. That shapes every role here: a whole area to own, more to build than there are people, and scope that expands with you. English is our working language, the team is international, the market is German.
Tasks
We are looking for a very particular kind of person.
Somebody who can move a brand forward in words, in images and emotionally, all three at once. How we come across is one thing, not three, and it falls apart the moment the copy, the visuals and the feeling get decided separately by people pulling in different directions.
Here is why it matters more here than in most companies. Our subject is bookkeeping, finance and annual accounts. Objectively one of the least exciting things a business owner deals with, and an industry that looks and sounds exactly like that. Our entire bet is that we do not feel like that industry: approachable, likeable, close to the customer, never intimidating. Somebody has to hold that line in every ad, every page, every video and every email, and keep holding it as the volume goes up.
We are asking people to hand over their books. Whether they trust us enough to do that is largely decided by how we come across, long before anybody speaks to sales. That is why this is one of our first senior hires rather than a later one.
how the job actually works
You make things. With AI in the loop, and without needing somebody else to execute before anything can go out.
That does not mean being the best in the room at everything. It means being good enough across the board to move on your own, and then deliberately bringing in people who are better than you at specific things. Freelancers first, colleagues later. A motion designer who is stronger than you are. An illustrator with a hand you do not have.
What stays with you either way is the judgment: what goes out, what does not, and why.
what you will do

Own how mika sounds and looks everywhere: ads, landing pages, website, social, video, decks, events
Write and make. Headlines, ad copy, page copy, campaign concepts, and the visuals that carry them.
Make a dry subject genuinely good. Boring is a choice, not a property of the material.

description_clean:
There are millions of small and medium businesses in Germany, and each one loses time and money to the same unavoidable work: bookkeeping, VAT returns, annual accounts. It has to be done, nobody enjoys it, and it costs more than it should.
mika takes that work off them. Compliance is not optional, which is why we think of what we build as infrastructure rather than as a product, and why the goal is to lower the cost of doing business in Germany.
We grew from 100 to over 700 customers in eight months with a small team, and that is the reason this role is as wide as it is: an entire area to own, more to build than hands to build it, and room that grows with you. English internally, international team, German market.
the market you would be marketing into
Until now a business owner in Germany believed they needed a tax advisor for their tax compliance. We built a second path. A tax advisor was simply a given, so most people are not out looking for something like us, and when they hear an alternative exists the reaction is usually positive surprise. Choosing one is also a big decision: several steps and several touchpoints before anyone moves. One ad and one landing page do not close it.
Aufgaben
Pipeline is your number, and it is the number the whole plan scales with. Today most of our customers arrive through paid channels. What has not existed so far is a single owner for the question of which campaign we run, on what topic, with what priority. That is yours from day one.
This is an end-to-end role. You own the whole path from a stranger to a customer, not only the part that carries an ad budget. Most conversions on that path are not sales: a newsletter signup, a guide download, a webinar registration, a reply. Somebody has to see those as one system, know which step is leaking, and be equally comfortable fixing a bid strategy and rewriting a nurture sequence.
On budget. You run a six-figure monthly media budget from the start, and if the results hold there is effectively no ceiling: you get as much as you can deploy at a payback we are happy with. That is the deal, and it cuts both ways.

Own campaign initiation and prioritisation: what we run, when, on what topic. That is the part nobody currently does.
Run paid acquisition hands-on across Paid Search and Paid Social
Own the whole conversion path, including the steps that produce no revenue on the day
Own the unit economics and build the model yourself: cost per qualified conversation, blended CAC, payback, cohort contribution
Reach people before they are searching. A growing share of our market is people founding a company or thinking about it, who are not yet looking for an accounting provider at all.
Give sales lead quality, not just lead volume, and take their feedback on which sources actually close
Set clear weekly priorities for the junior people who support paid

Where your job ends. Our growth engineer builds the pages and the tracking, our creative lead produces the assets, and lifecycle sequences belong to our CRM and lifecycle manager. You own the campaigns, the briefs and the numbers.
Qualifikation
what you bring to the table

AI-native, not AI-curious. Claude or an equivalent is your daily sparring partner rather than a tool you open occasionally. You augment your own output with it and you automate the parts of your job that should not need a human.
You have generated pipeline as your own number, not supported somebody else who did
We have a strong bias towards people who have been entrepreneurs themselves, whether that was your own company or a function you ran as if it were one
You do not rely on anyone else to manage the channels for you. At least at the start you run the full cycle hands-on, ideally across both paid search and paid social.
You understand the entire cycle, from first touch through the soft conversions to closed revenue, and you know what a newsletter subscriber is worth to you
You understand unit economics well enough to build the model yourself
You have marketed a complex product where the buyer has to be taught something before they can buy, and you can build demand where there is no search volume to harvest
You have taste and you use it. You know within seconds whether a creative will work and whether it looks like a premium brand.
You take direct feedback without turning it into a debate

the level we are hiring at

If you have been the second person in a function somewhere good and this is your step up, that is the profile we want. As the team grows, the path from here leads to Head of or VP of this area.
We keep the team small by giving people leverage instead of headcount. That is why the AI point above is a requirement rather than a preference.

nice to have

German SMB audience, fintech or another regulated category. A product-led lane running next to a sales-led one. A network of specialists you can pull on. HubSpot, GA4, GTM and a working relationship with SQL.

German at C1 or above is required. Roughly 80 to 90 percent of what we run is in German, and judging whether a piece of copy lands is part of the job rather than something you can hand off. English at B2 or above, since English is our working language.
Benefits
Base 70,000 to 95,000 EUR depending on experience, plus a variable component tied to pipeline and payback, plus stock options. We would rather put a real range here than leave you guessing.
Three rounds: an intro conversation, a working session with a short case, and a final round with the founders. There is also a conversation with one of our investors or mentors, in this case somebody who knows demand generation properly. One meeting happens in person in Berlin, and you hear back within a week at every stage, including if the answer is no.
why mika?

Nobody has owned this before you. No predecessor's system to inherit, no playbook to follow, and nobody above you deciding what you may test.
Room, and the expectation that you use it. We hire people who do not need managing and then give them space to grow into more than the job they were hired for. Fully flexible hours apart from the daily standup.
Founders in the detail with you, and no layer between you and a decision
The freedom to kill what does not work, including things we started before you arrived
Work that matters outside the building. Every customer we win gets back time and money that was disappearing into paperwork.

Send us your CV and one campaign you are proud of, with the numbers behind it.

description_clean:
Germany runs on its small and medium businesses, and far too much of their money and attention goes into staying compliant. Bookkeeping, VAT returns, annual accounts: unavoidable work that nobody wants and everybody overpays for.
We take it off them. Because none of it is optional, what we are building is infrastructure rather than software, and the purpose is simple: make it cheaper to run a company in Germany.
100 to more than 700 customers in eight months, and still a small team. So these roles are broad by design. You own an area, not a slice of one, there is more to build than there are people, and the scope grows as fast as you do. We work in English internally, as the team is international, but the market is German.
Aufgaben
You own our sales engine: the team, the numbers and the motions we sell through.
What you inherit on day one. Two sales people, one freelance closer, and everything our COO and CFO has been carrying alongside his actual job. So you are a playing coach for the first months: you carry your own book, you coach two people, and you hire the next ones yourself rather than being handed a team.
Our pipeline today is almost entirely inbound. Outbound is a motion we expect to build, and we do not yet know how large a part of the mix it becomes. We need somebody who has run both, because the answer depends on what you find.
We have deliberately not decided what the sales team should look like. There are too many sensible ways to build one, and the right shape depends on which motions prove out. You design that structure with us and then you hire it, which is why hiring experience is not negotiable in this role.
what you will do

Own win rate, cycle time and average contract value as your numbers, per motion rather than in aggregate
Own sales operations and bring structure to a team that has grown without much of it: process, cadence, forecasting, routing rules, quota and commission design, a CRM somebody can trust
Design the shape of the sales team with us, then hire it. Which roles, which split, in which order.
Hire, onboard and coach the reps. You are accountable for who joins the team, not only for what they do afterwards.
Run inbound properly and build outbound from close to nothing, then be honest about which one deserves the next hire
Build the consultative motion for larger contract values. Our subscription tiers are small, and a meaningful part of first-year revenue comes from one-off work such as prior-year closings, which is where the larger deals sit.
Use the deadlines the business already has. VAT returns, annual accounts, the notice period on an existing advisor contract: there is always a clock, and finding it and using it is a large part of closing here.
Keep selling. You should be closing enough yourself to know what the reps are hearing.

Where your job ends. Our partnerships manager closes the partner agreements, including grey label. You own the routing of those leads and their conversion into revenue.
Qualifikation
what you bring to the table

AI-native, not AI-curious. Claude or an equivalent is your daily sparring partner rather than a tool you open occasionally. You augment your own output with it and you automate the parts of your job that should not need a human. In this role that means call analysis and objection patterns, follow-up drafting, research before a conversation, and the reporting you would otherwise ask somebody else to build for you.
You have hired sales people before, and some of them worked out. You can describe what you screen for and what you got wrong.
We have a strong bias towards people who have been entrepreneurs themselves, whether that was your own company or a function you ran as if it were one
You have run both inbound and outbound yourself, not managed one and read about the other
You have led a small B2B sales team in a high-volume environment and carried the number yourself before that
You build structure without building bureaucracy. Playbooks and process that reps actually use.
You can tell the difference between a rep who processes what arrives and a rep who goes and gets it, in an interview rather than in month four
You are commercially literate. You can hold a conversation about pricing, structure and what a deal can afford without escalating every question.
You coach directly and you are honest about who is not working out
You are honest in the CRM even when the number is ugly

the level we are hiring at
If you have been the second person in a function somewhere good and this is your step up, that is the profile we want. As the team grows, the path from here is Head of Sales.
We keep the team small by giving people leverage instead of headcount. That is why the AI point above is a requirement rather than a preference, and why we expect everyone here to get visibly better at it every month.

Tax, accounting, SME-stack or fintech background
Franchise systems, multi-entity groups or holding structures
Partner-led or channel sales
Experience in a company that grew fast around you

German at native or C2 level is required. Every sales conversation, every negotiation and every coaching session on a live call happens in German. English at B2 or above, since English is our team language.
Benefits
Base 75,000 to 100,000 EUR depending on experience, plus a variable component. It starts weighted to what you close yourself and shifts toward team performance as the team grows. On-target earnings 95,000 to 150,000 EUR+, plus stock options.
Three rounds: an intro conversation, a working session with a short case, and a final round with the founders. why mika?

The engine is yours to build. Selling here already works. Turning it into a system is the job, which means you are deciding what it looks like rather than inheriting somebody else's.
Room, and the expectation that you use it. We hire people who do not need managing and then give them space to grow into more than the job they were hired for. Fully flexible hours apart from the daily standup.
Founders in the detail with you, and no layer between you and a decision
A category nobody has built. German business owners do not know an alternative to their tax advisor exists, so you are opening a market rather than taking share in one.
Work that matters outside the building. Every customer you close gets back time and money that was disappearing into paperwork.

It will come from controlling matter with enough precision that fusion becomes a manufacturable technology, atoms aligned exactly enough that fusion happens under controlled conditions, on a chip. We start in physics and simulation, then build the physical proof. About the RoleReaching a chip-scale approach means working through physics and simulation at a depth that is hard to reach by conventional means, and to do that we need a new class of scientific intelligence. The systems you build will be used to accelerate research in fusion energy, scientific discovery, advanced simulation, AI for physics and quantum technologies. Success here is measured in real scientific progress.Work with an exceptional founding team with scientific and commercial track records across places like LMU, Apple, Amazon, Eurazeo, Sprin-D and McKinsey. Around them is a small group of physicists, simulation experts and AI specialists who value curiosity, independent thinking and the courage to challenge assumptions.We are remote-first, so you can work from Munich, Berlin, London, Lisbon or wherever you do your best work. A strong focus will be placed on agentic workflows, RAG, tool use, structured outputs, responsible AI, and human oversight. This is an opportunity to work at the forefront of enterprise AI while helping organizations adopt powerful technologies securely and responsibly. Travel to clients and conferences may be required as needed.
Accountabilities

Architect, develop, deploy, and maintain scalable AI, machine learning, generative AI, and agentic AI solutions for enterprise use cases.
Define end-to-end architectures covering data ingestion and preparation, model selection, orchestration, APIs, integrations, user experiences, monitoring, security, and governance.
Partner with business and technical stakeholders to identify high-value AI opportunities, translate requirements into technical designs, and establish delivery roadmaps.
Lead technical discovery sessions, architecture workshops, design reviews, proof-of-concepts, demonstrations, and solution delivery activities.
Design and implement LLM-powered applications using Claude, Anthropic APIs, and other appropriate LLM platforms.
Apply prompt and context engineering techniques, including instruction design, few-shot examples, structured inputs and outputs, response constraints, and long-context management.
Architect secure RAG solutions using enterprise documents, knowledge bases, databases, and other approved information sources, including ingestion, chunking, embeddings, retrieval, reranking, citations, and response generation.
Build agentic systems capable of reasoning over enterprise context, using authorized tools, executing multi-step tasks, and coordinating workflows across enterprise applications.

Integrate AI agents and workflows with ServiceNow, enterprise APIs, cloud services, databases, collaboration platforms, and operational systems.
Implement human-in-the-loop controls and safeguards for sensitive, high-impact, low-confidence, or exception-based actions.
Develop machine learning and NLP solutions for predictive analytics, classification, clustering, forecasting, anomaly detection, recommendation, document intelligence, summarization, and intelligent automation.
Build data-processing, feature-engineering, ETL/ELT, and model pipelines that support reliable training, deployment, monitoring, and data quality.
Design and implement AI solutions across AWS, Microsoft Azure, and/or Google Cloud, using services such as SageMaker, Lambda, S3, and Vertex AI where appropriate.
Develop supporting APIs, microservices, automation components, and integrations required to operationalize AI solutions.

Measure and optimize AI solutions across accuracy, relevance, groundedness, safety, task completion, latency, cost, reliability, and user experience.

Document architecture decisions, system behavior, limitations, risk controls, operating procedures, and support requirements.
Design AI-enabled experiences and workflow automations for areas such as employee support, customer service, IT operations, knowledge management, chatbots, virtual agents, and workflow automation.
Create reusable implementation patterns, agent designs, integration components, evaluation assets, and accelerators to support enterprise AI delivery.
Develop dashboards and executive-ready reporting using tools such as Tableau and Power BI to demonstrate adoption, business value, operational performance, and model quality.
Travel to clients and conferences as required.

10+ years of professional experience applying AI, machine learning, data science, software engineering, or intelligent automation technologies to practical enterprise use cases.
Strong hands-on programming skills in Python and SQL, with experience using TensorFlow, PyTorch, Scikit-learn, or comparable machine learning frameworks.
Proven experience architecting or delivering AI/ML, LLM, RAG, conversational AI, agentic AI, or AI-powered automation solutions.
Strong understanding of software architecture, algorithms, object-oriented programming, functional design principles, APIs, and integration patterns.
Practical knowledge of LLM application development, including prompt engineering, context management, tokens, embeddings, vector search, RAG, tool use, structured outputs, and model evaluation.
Experience with data-science libraries such as Pandas, NumPy, Matplotlib, and Seaborn.
Hands-on experience with one or more major cloud platforms, particularly AWS, Azure, and/or Google Cloud.
Experience with big-data technologies and cloud data platforms, including Apache Spark and Snowflake.
Strong NLP experience with Hugging Face, transformer models, cloud AI services, or comparable technologies.
Solid understanding of databases, query optimization, data warehousing, ETL/ELT pipelines, and data-quality practices.
Experience with data visualization and reporting tools such as Tableau and Power BI.
Strong knowledge of responsible AI, including privacy, security, human oversight, hallucination mitigation, prompt-injection defenses, model limitations, and governed deployment.
Strong architectural thinking, analytical ability, problem-solving skills, and attention to detail.
Excellent communication and stakeholder-management skills, with the ability to collaborate across client, consulting, engineering, product, data, and AI/ML teams.
Ability to work effectively in a rapidly evolving technology environment and adapt to changing AI capabilities and enterprise requirements.
Experience with Claude, the Anthropic API, Anthropic Console, Claude Code, or Anthropic-focused implementation practices is highly desirable.
Familiarity with Model Context Protocol (MCP) concepts and secure approaches to connecting AI applications with enterprise tools and data is a plus.
Experience designing AI agents, multi-agent systems, orchestration workflows, and human-in-the-loop operating models is advantageous.
Familiarity with frameworks such as LangChain, LangGraph, LlamaIndex, Semantic Kernel, or comparable LLM application frameworks is a plus.
Experience with vector databases, semantic retrieval, embeddings, document ingestion, reranking, and RAG evaluation is desirable.
Familiarity with AI observability, tracing, prompt/version management, evaluation frameworks, guardrails, model monitoring, and cost optimization is beneficial.
Experience with MLOps, LLMOps, CI/CD, Docker, Kubernetes, infrastructure as code, and production cloud deployment practices is a plus.

Advanced degrees and relevant AI, cloud, data, ServiceNow, or Anthropic certifications are advantageous.

Collaboration with multidisciplinary and cross-functional teams spanning consulting, engineering, data, AI/ML, and enterprise technology.

Professional growth through exposure to rapidly evolving AI technologies, methodologies, and enterprise use cases.

Briefings, die ohne dich funktionieren. Du schreibst Creative-Briefings, die Editoren und UGC-Creator eigenständig umsetzen. So klar, dass niemand nachfragen muss.
Performance lesen, Hypothesen ableiten. Du liest die Creative-Performance aus dem Ads Manager, ziehst Schlüsse und briefst die nächste Iteration. CVR, CAC, AOV und ROAS sind für dich kein Reporting, sondern Werkzeug.

Nachweisbare Ergebnisse mit Meta Video Ads (VSLs, UGC-Style, Hook-Testing).

Sehr gutes Deutsch. Du schreibst Copy, die sich liest wie ein Brief an eine gute Bekannte. Nicht wie ein Beipackzettel. Niveau, das verkauft, nicht Niveau, das beeindruckt.

title: Product Manager (DevTools & AI Reliability, remote)
description_clean: (Fully remote, async-first, DevTools SaaS, 40h/week, time zones: UTC-3 to UTC+3)The best developers don't wait for a customer to tell them something's broken.They catch it first, in the pull request, in staging, or in the checkout flow at 3am, before a single user notices. That instinct is Checkly's whole reason to exist. We give developers and their agents the tools to own reliability the way they own their code: monitoring defined as code, powered by OpenTelemetry and Playwright, versioned and reviewed like everything else they ship. From pull request to post-mortem, in one place.Thousands of them, from modern AI companies like Mistral and resolve.ai to large engineering orgs like LinkedIn, Citi, and 1Password, build with us. Now we need a PM who wants to take that further, in a market being rewritten in real time.Here's the thing about 2026: AI agents and coding assistants are shipping more software, faster, than any team could review by hand, and more of it is breaking in ways nobody has seen before. LLM-backed features fail probabilistically. Agents take actions no runbook anticipated. "Is my app healthy?" is becoming an unanswerable question for a whole generation of AI-native software. Nobody has really figured out what reliability means for this kind of software yet. That's the problem you'd own.What you'll doAs a Product Manager, you will be responsible for empowering developers and designers to solve customer problems. You will work directly with our SVP Product Engineering Daniel.You will:Shape company and product strategy alongside our SVP of Product Engineering. It's a genuine partnership: you'll develop the vision for where Checkly goes next, decide where we play in the AI testing, monitoring, and observability landscape and where we don't, and turn that into a direction. You build the strategy with us, not execute someone else's.Shape Checkly's point of view on reliability in an AI-native world: how teams monitor AI-generated code, agent-driven workflows, and LLM-backed featuresLead initiatives across Product Engineering, Sales and Marketing, and represent Checkly directly to customers and in developer communities.Live in the product and the problem. Empathy for DevOps, SRE and Platform Engineering isn't a line item. It's the job.You ship with AI where it helps and know when not to. You don't just talk about it.What you should haveYou've built software before this. You're an ex-engineer, ex-founder, or ex-solutions engineer who has written real code and shipped real things, and now you want to own the product. This one's non-negotiable: you should be able to reason about APIs, MCPs, CLIs, and how systems fit together without a translator.You've worked in a startup, not just a big company. You're comfortable with ambiguity, small teams, and owning outcomes end to end. You don't need a big-company machine around you to be effective.You've built technical products, ideally developer tools. Adjacent technical products count. Experience in monitoring or observability is a nice-to-have, not a requirement.New to the PM title? That's fine. If you're coming from a founding or solutions-engineering seat and want to go all-in on product, we want to hear from you.You're technical enough to be dangerous with AI tooling. You can prototype in code, throw together a mock, or pressure-test technical viability yourself when it moves things forward.FULLY remote role, within the UTC-3 to UTC+3 time zones. Need to be able to travel to (other) European countries without having to wait for a visa appointment.What you will hate about usWe would rather tell you now than have you find out in month two.We use AI for everything, and we mean everything. We are async-first, so a lot of decisions happen in documents and threads, not meetings. If you do your best thinking out loud in a room full of people, you will miss it here.We are lean, so you own the boring parts too. There is no PM ops layer to delegate the unglamorous work to. description_clean:
Vino Digital ist die E-Commerce-Agentur für die Weinbranche und ein Geschäftsbereich der TAFKA GmbH. Für unser Team suchen wir eine berufserfahrene Person, die digitale Projekte eigenständig führt, technische Themen sicher einordnet und bei Bedarf direkt in die Umsetzung geht. An einem Tag steuerst du ein Kundenprojekt, am nächsten löst du ein Problem mit Shop, DNS oder Tracking, schneidest ein Video in DaVinci Resolve oder entwickelst mit Claude und Codex einen besseren Workflow.
Du arbeitest eng mit unserem Team und der Geschäftsführung zusammen. Du bringst Ordnung in komplexe Situationen, kommunizierst klar und führst Projekte zuverlässig zum Ergebnis. Wenn du Verantwortung magst, digitale Systeme schnell verstehst und einen vielseitigen Arbeitsalltag suchst, sollten wir uns kennenlernen.
Aufgaben

Digitale Projekte führen: Du übernimmst Vino-Digital-Projekte von der Planung bis zum Abschluss, setzt Prioritäten, koordinierst Beteiligte und hältst Zeit, Qualität und nächste Schritte im Blick.
Kunden sicher begleiten: Du bist zentrale Ansprechperson für ausgewählte Partnerweingüter, führst Termine, übersetzt Ziele in klare Arbeitspakete und löst Probleme proaktiv.
Systeme weiterentwickeln: Du sammelst wiederkehrende Anforderungen, priorisierst Verbesserungen, formulierst saubere Briefings für Entwicklung und Automatisierung, testest neue Funktionen und dokumentierst den fertigen Prozess.
Technische Themen lösen: Du arbeitest sicher mit CMS, Domains, DNS-Einträgen, Formularen, Tracking und Integrationen. Bei Fehlern grenzt du die Ursache systematisch ein und organisierst eine belastbare Lösung.
Web und E-Commerce umsetzen: Du pflegst und verbesserst Seiten in Shopify, WordPress oder vergleichbaren Systemen und kannst kleinere Anpassungen selbst durchführen.
Videos produzieren: Du schneidest Social-, Performance-, Schulungs- und Kunden-Videos in DaVinci Resolve, inklusive Auswahl, Dramaturgie, Ton, Untertiteln und passenden Exportformaten.
AI-first arbeiten: Du nutzt Claude und Codex täglich für Planung, Recherche, Dokumentation, Troubleshooting, Text, Prototyping und kleine technische Umsetzungen. Ergebnisse prüfst und verbesserst du eigenständig.
TAFKA unterstützen: Je nach Auslastung übernimmst du passende Aufgaben in KI-, Automatisierungs- oder Content-Projekten von TAFKA, etwa Projektkoordination, Prototyping, Video-Deliverables oder Qualitätssicherung.
Standards verbessern: Du erkennst wiederkehrende Reibung, entwickelst Vorlagen und Prozesse weiter und sorgst dafür, dass gute Lösungen im Team wiederverwendbar werden.

Qualifikation

Du bringst mindestens drei Jahre relevante Berufserfahrung in einer Agentur, einem Digitalunternehmen, einem E-Commerce-Team, einem Start-up oder einem vergleichbaren Umfeld mit.
Du hast mehrere digitale Projekte mit eigener Kunden- oder Stakeholder-Verantwortung geführt und kannst konkret erklären, welche schwierigen Situationen du gelöst und welche Ergebnisse du erreicht hast.
Du kommunizierst verbindlich, priorisierst klar und bleibst handlungsfähig, wenn Anforderungen unvollständig sind oder kurz vor einem Termin ein Problem auftaucht.
Du verstehst die Grundlagen von Domains und DNS. Begriffe wie A-Record, CNAME, MX und TXT sind dir vertraut.
Du hast bereits eine Website oder einen Shop mit WordPress, Shopify, Webflow oder einem vergleichbaren CMS umgesetzt oder wesentlich weiterentwickelt.
Du hast praktische Schnitt-Erfahrung mit DaVinci Resolve und kannst Arbeitsproben zeigen. Grundlagen bei Ton, Farbe, Untertiteln und Social-Formaten sitzen.
Du nutzt Claude, Codex oder vergleichbare KI-Werkzeuge routiniert und kannst zeigen, wie du damit Qualität, Tempo oder Problemlösung verbessert hast.
Du dokumentierst Entscheidungen und Prozesse so, dass andere damit weiterarbeiten können.
Du arbeitest auf Deutsch mindestens auf C1-Niveau und kannst dich im beruflichen Alltag auf Englisch verständigen.
Du kannst regelmäßig in unserem Büro nahe Ostkreuz in Berlin arbeiten: 3 Tage pro Woche

Ein Studium ist keine Voraussetzung. Entscheidend sind deine Berufspraxis, dein Urteilsvermögen und die Ergebnisse, für die du bereits Verantwortung getragen hast. Erfahrung mit Vibe Coding, APIs, Webhooks oder Automationen ist willkommen.
Benefits

Echte Verantwortung: Du führst eigene Projekte und hast direkten Einfluss auf Kunden, Abläufe und Produktqualität.
Abwechslungsreiche Arbeit mit erkennbarem Kern: Projektmanagement bildet deine Basis. Technik, Systeme, Video und KI geben dir Raum, weitere Stärken einzusetzen.
Zwei spannende Arbeitsfelder: Du arbeitest überwiegend für Vino Digital und kannst dich zusätzlich in ausgewählte KI- und Automatisierungsprojekte von TAFKA einbringen.
AI-first-Umfeld: Claude, Codex und moderne Automatisierungswerkzeuge gehören zu unserem Arbeitsalltag. Gute Experimente können schnell zum neuen Standard werden.
Kurze Entscheidungswege: Du arbeitest direkt mit dem Team und der Geschäftsführung und kannst Verbesserungen selbst anstoßen.
Gute Ausstattung: Du erhältst ein Firmen-MacBook und die Software, die du für deine Arbeit brauchst.
Hybrides Arbeiten: 3 pro Woche arbeiten wir gemeinsam in unserem Büro nahe Ostkreuz, die übrige Zeit ist flexibel. Remote Work über einen abgestimmten Zeitraum nach Probezeit problemlos möglich.

Du hast schon erlebt, wie digitale Projekte in der Realität laufen: mit Kundenwünschen, Abhängigkeiten, technischen Überraschungen und Entscheidungen unter Zeitdruck. Du behältst den Überblick, packst selbst mit an und findest einen gangbaren nächsten Schritt.

deinen Lebenslauf mit den Projekten, für die du selbst Verantwortung getragen hast

mindestens eine Video-Arbeitsprobe
ein Beispiel, wie du Claude, Codex oder ein anderes KI-Werkzeug in deiner Arbeit eingesetzt hast

Technische Fragestellungen bearbeiten: Anforderungen verstehen, Annahmen festhalten, Lösungswege vergleichen und Ergebnisse plausibilisieren.

KI als Ingenieurwerkzeug einsetzen: Für Recherche, Berechnung, Code und Dokumentation — mit kritischer Prüfung statt blindem Übernehmen.

Python sowie Bibliotheken wie NumPy, SymPy, CoolProp oder TesPy.

Mauser Packaging Solutions ist ein globaler Marktführer von hochwertigen und wegweisenden Verpackungen für industrielle Zwecke. Das Leistungsspektrum umfasst ein vielfältiges Produktportfolio, zu dem Kunststoffverpackungen, Fibertrommeln, Stahlfässer, Intermediate Bulk Container (IBC) in verschiedenen Größen sowie die Rücknahme gebrauchter Verpackungen gehören (Rekonditionierung). Leitung von Projekten zur Durchführung von Reparaturen, Überholungen und Verlagerung von Produktionsanlagen; Erstellen von Termin- und Kostenplänen

Reinigung / Begutachtung von Bauteilen und bei Bedarf Einholen und Abstimmen von Angeboten

Erstellung von Lastenheften
Erstellung von systematischen Wartungsplänen
Durchführung von Schulungen in den Bereichen Reparatur und Instandhaltung
Erstellen von Serviceanweisungen und Anleitungen

description_clean:
About Wolt
At Wolt, we create technology that brings joy, simplicity and earnings to the neighborhoods of the world. In 2014 we started with delivery of restaurant food. Now we're building the delivery of (almost) everything and you'll find us in over 500 cities in 30 countries around the world. In 2022 we joined forces with DoorDash and together we keep on dreaming big and expanding across the globe.Working at Wolt isn't always easy, but it's definitely exciting. Here you'll learn more, build more, and ship more than in most other companies. You'll be challenged a lot, but also have a lot of fun on the way. So, if you're a self-starter with drive and entrepreneurial spirit, this could be the ride of your life.About the role
Every contact that reaches a customer support agent, and every credit issued to customers, represents a defect somewhere in our system. This role exists to help find those defects, trace them to their source, and work with the teams responsible to eliminate them at a systemic level.
This is a high impact senior program management role within the EMEA Customer Experience organisation, reporting to the Director of Defect Elimination and Customer Experience. The Senior Program Manager is accountable for turning customer experience signals from Wolt and/or Deliveroo markets into clear, actionable insight, and for driving the resulting fixes through to resolution with partner teams.
What you'll be doing

You will own the delivery of the defect elimination program across EMEA, including application of the defect driver taxonomy to identify where defect rate concentrates, and where customer outcomes are worst. You will build a clear, prioritised list of issues for partner teams to work through.
You will represent the voice of the customer in the rooms where decisions get made about your markets. That means preparing and presenting data in product reviews, weekly/monthly business reviews and planning sessions, so the cost of poor customer experience is concrete and attributable, and so partner teams understand what is being asked of them and why.
You will build working relationships with partner teams in engineering, marketplace operations, courier operations, and finance, and you will track the fixes they commit to through to completion. You will feed results back into the program so everyone can see what worked, and to ensure defects are eliminated for good.
You will maintain and improve the data infrastructure and reporting that underpins this work, ensuring customer experience insights are credible, available and actionable.

Our humble expectations

The right person for this role has spent time inside a large-scale customer experience or operations function, and has direct experience translating customer defects through identification, root cause analysis and resolution. They are comfortable working with imperfect data, and they know how to build a credible case when the evidence is directional rather than conclusive.
Strong analytical instincts are essential. This person needs to know what questions to ask of the data and whether the answers make sense. Prior exposure to a successful voice of the customer (VoC) program is critical.
There is a meaningful cross-functional dimension to the role. This person will spend real time getting other teams to prioritise work that benefits the customer but may compete with other priorities. That requires good judgement, clear communication, and the ability to build trust quickly with people outside their reporting line.
The role also requires the ability to drive results in a dynamic and ambiguous landscape. The right person will combine introducing structure and rigor, while being agile and responsive to changing priorities and emerging issues. 

This is a high impact and high visibility role, with the opportunity to interact with stakeholders and teams across the full customer lifecycle. The role will also span across 40 EMEA Roo & Wolt markets, meaning there is an opportunity to drive financial and customer experience results at scale.
Next steps
You will first meet with our Talent Acquisition team to understand role and company fit. Then, you will meet with the Hiring Manager who will talk through your relevant experience and ask you competency based questions that assess your suitability for the role. The third stage is an assignment, where you will be given a business problem to think through, and present back to the team. If successful, there may be a final conversation with a more senior stakeholder. Throughout all stages, you will have plenty of opportunities to ask any questions about the role, team or company.

We're committed to growing and empowering a more inclusive community within our company, industry, and cities. Partnerschaft auf Augenhöhe.
Wir stellen uns vor.
Seit nunmehr 20 Jahren stellen wir an unseren beiden Standorten in Bad Homburg und Darmstadt einen verlässlichen Partner dar – für unsere breitgefächerte Mandantschaft und allen voran für unser loyales, knapp 30-köpfiges Team. Herausforderungen im Kollektiv anzugehen ist nicht nur förderlich für das Wohlbefinden innerhalb unserer heiligen Hallen – es ist auch noch die perfekte Grundlage für eine vielversprechende Karriere, bei der wir Dich selbstverständlich unterstützen werden.
Aufgaben
So vielfältig wie das Steuerrecht.
Dein Aufgabengebiet.
Wie ein klassischer Tag bei SBC aussieht? Das hängt ganz von Dir ab! Denn Deinen individuellen Tätigkeitsbereich erstellen wir, natürlich in enger Abstimmung mit Dir, basierend auf Deinen Interessen, Talenten und Fähigkeiten. Und da jeder Mensch seine eigenen Stärken (und Schwächen) hat, gestaltet sich Dein Arbeitsalltag ganz nach Deinem Geschmack. Unter anderem erwarten Dich folgende Aufgaben:

Eigenverantwortliche Betreuung unserer Mandanten
Finanzbuchhaltung
Erstellen von Steuererklärungen und Jahresabschlüssen
Bearbeitung steuerlicher Fragestellungen
Vorbereitung und Begleitung von Betriebsprüfungen
Kommunikation mit Mandanten
Weitere Tätigkeiten, die Dir Spaß bereiten

Qualifikation
Wir bringen Dich weiter.
Und Du bringst ein paar Dinge mit.
Wir sind innerhalb der Branche für eine oft langjährige Zusammenarbeit bekannt – mit Mitarbeitern und Mandanten. Dies ist ein Indikator dafür, dass sich das Team und die Mandantschaft bei uns wohlfühlen und auch in beruflicher Hinsicht zufrieden mit unserer Kanzlei sind. Eine ausgeprägte Teamfähigkeit und eine verlässliche, strukturierte Arbeitsweise sind daher nicht verhandelbar. Zudem legst Du folgende Eigenschaften an den Tag:

Ausbildung zum Steuerfachangestellten, Steuerfachwirt oder Bilanzbuchhalter (alle m/w/d)
Gute Kenntnisse in MS-Office und DATEV
Im Optimalfall 2 Jahre Berufserfahrung
Digitalisierung ist für Dich der nötige Fortschritt
Veränderungen gegenüber bist Du aufgeschlossen

Benefits
Wer etwas will, muss auch etwas zu bieten haben.
Und das haben wir!
Obstkörbe und Gratis-Kaffee sind zwar schön, aber sicherlich nicht der entscheidende Faktor, wenn es um die Zufriedenheit des Teams geht. Um einen attraktiven Arbeitgeber darzustellen, bedarf es spürbarer Benefits und Annehmlichkeiten, die sowohl das Berufs- als auch das Privatleben positiv beeinflussen und Dir den Alltag erleichtern. Dazu gehört beispielsweise, dass der Zusammenhalt und ein angenehmes Miteinander über dem Umsatz stehen sollten – Mitarbeiter*innen, die schlechte Stimmung verbreiten und ihre Ellbogen ausfahren, haben keinen Platz in unserer Mitte. Da gehen wir keine Kompromisse ein. Außerdem erwarten Dich:
Flexible Arbeitszeiten und Modelle, inklusive Home-Office:
Uns ist wichtig, dass die Qualität Deiner Arbeit stimmt – wann und wo Du diese erbringst, spielt eher eine sekundäre Rolle.

Work-Life-Balance:
Arbeit ist wichtig, jedoch nicht das Wichtigste im Leben. Um Berufs- und Privatleben optimal unter einen Hut zu bekommen, bedarf es der Unterstützung Deines Arbeitgebers – auf uns kannst Du zählen.
Team-Events:
Nur eine Weihnachtsfeier und das war’s wieder für ein Jahr? Nicht bei uns – regelmäßige ausgefallene Veranstaltungen wie Städtetrips, Krimi-Dinner, Ski-Ausflüge und andere gemeinsame Happy Hours wie Restaurantbesuche sorgen dafür, dass es auch neben dem Kanzleialltag nie langweilig wird.
Fort- und Weiterbildungsangebote:
Man kann Fachkräfte einkaufen oder auf die eigenen Talente setzen. Durch weitreichende Fortbildungsangebote helfen wir Dir, die Karriereleiter nach oben zu klettern. Ob nun durch unsere substanzielle und finanzielle Unterstützung oder unsere erfahrenen Kolleg*innen, die Dir stets zur Seite stehen.
Offene Kultur:
In unserer Kanzlei wirst Du offene Türen, flache Hierarchien, kurze Kommunikations- und Entscheidungswege und eine wertschätzende Duz-Kultur vorfinden. Ein fachlicher Austausch mit den Berufsträger*innen ist nicht nur jederzeit möglich, sondern wird auch gern gesehen.
Weitere Annehmlichkeiten:
Kanzleieigene Parkplätze, monatliche Sachbezüge in Höhe von 50 € und eine betriebliche Altersvorsorge gestalten Deinen Alltag angenehmer – beruflich und privat!
Was darf’s sonst noch sein?
Wie schon bemerkt, sind alle Menschen verschieden. Wenn Dir etwas auf dem Herzen liegt, das Du gerne in unserem Benefit-Portfolio aufnehmen willst, sag uns einfach Bescheid. Wir können über alles reden: E-Bike? Firmenhandy? Lass es uns wissen!

Der Ball liegt nun bei Dir.
Nein, das ist keine Dating-Plattform, fühlt sich aber fast so an. Wenn Dir gefällt, was Du liest, kannst Du Dich innerhalb weniger Minuten bei uns bewerben – vielleicht wird es ja DAS perfekte Match?

title: Solutions Architect
description_clean: About PlanePlane's mission is to build the infrastructure the world's work runs on. Every organization runs on three things: the projects it's driving, the knowledge it keeps, and the requests it fields. Plane brings all three into one open, adaptable platform: simple enough for any team to adopt, dependable enough for organizations to build on. And we are building it for a future where humans and AI agents do that work together. Plane began in public on GitHub at the end of 2022. Since then it has grown into a work management platform used by teams around the world: 55,000+ stars, 5,000+ forks, and a contributor community that reads our code and files our issues. Organizations run Plane as a managed Cloud service, on their own infrastructure, or inside fully isolated environments. Building in the open keeps us close to users and raises the standard for everything we ship. Plane is the #1 work infrastructure in aerospace, defense, financial services, and other regulated industries: organizations whose requirements for control, auditability, and data residency rule most software out. When the strictest buyers pick a system of record, that choice means something. Adoption is growing fastest on Plane Cloud and in sovereign clouds, deployments that keep everything inside a country's own borders and rules. Plane is backed by top investors and built across San Francisco, London, and Hyderabad. We work in tightly knit teams, stay close to users, and care about the visible product as much as the unglamorous details that make software dependable. People own problems end to end, and we add process only when it helps the work. Humans and agentsWe believe the next decade of work will be done by humans and AI agents together. Not agents replacing people, and not a chat window bolted onto software built for humans clicking around, but both working in one system of action, where an agent's work is as visible and as accountable as a person's. Most software treats AI as a feature. We treat agents as a kind of worker, and that changes what the system underneath has to be. Agents are only as good as the context they can see and the state they are allowed to change, so shared context, explicit state, durable history, and accountable action are not items on our roadmap. They are the product. Plane is built so that when an agent acts, the humans responsible can see what happened, why, and on whose authority, and the record survives. This is what the infrastructure is for: making the future where humans and agents work together useful, legible, and fully within the organization's control. Every role at Plane is some part of building that. About the roleOur largest customers do not buy Plane off the shelf. A bank wants it behind their firewall with SSO tied to their identity provider; a defense contractor wants it air-gapped with a migration plan from three legacy tools at once. You will own the technical architecture for these deployments before the contract is signed and after, translating what a customer's infrastructure and compliance team requires into a Plane deployment that actually holds up. You will work directly with sales on the largest deals we run and with engineering when a customer's requirements push past what we support today. Every organization runs on three things: the projects it's driving, the knowledge it keeps, and the requests it fields. Plane brings all three into one open, adaptable platform: simple enough for any team to adopt, dependable enough for organizations to build on. And we are building it for a future where humans and AI agents do that work together. Plane began in public on GitHub at the end of 2022. Since then it has grown into a work management platform used by teams around the world: 55,000+ stars, 5,000+ forks, and a contributor community that reads our code and files our issues. Organizations run Plane as a managed Cloud service, on their own infrastructure, or inside fully isolated environments. Building in the open keeps us close to users and raises the standard for everything we ship. Plane is the #1 work infrastructure in aerospace, defense, financial services, and other regulated industries: organizations whose requirements for control, auditability, and data residency rule most software out. When the strictest buyers pick a system of record, that choice means something. Adoption is growing fastest on Plane Cloud and in sovereign clouds, deployments that keep everything inside a country's own borders and rules. Plane is backed by top investors and built across San Francisco, London, and Hyderabad. We work in tightly knit teams, stay close to users, and care about the visible product as much as the unglamorous details that make software dependable. People own problems end to end, and we add process only when it helps the work. Humans and agentsWe believe the next decade of work will be done by humans and AI agents together. Not agents replacing people, and not a chat window bolted onto software built for humans clicking around, but both working in one system of action, where an agent's work is as visible and as accountable as a person's.  Most software treats AI as a feature. We treat agents as a kind of worker, and that changes what the system underneath has to be. Agents are only as good as the context they can see and the state they are allowed to change, so shared context, explicit state, durable history, and accountable action are not items on our roadmap. They are the product. Plane is built so that when an agent acts, the humans responsible can see what happened, why, and on whose authority, and the record survives. This is what the infrastructure is for: making the future where humans and agents work together useful, legible, and fully within the organization's control. Every role at Plane is some part of building that. About the rolePlane has over a million users, and Fortune 500 companies deploying Plane. Enterprises in aerospace, defense, healthcare, and finance are running Plane in production — some in air-gapped, classified environments. The commercial demand is real and growing. This role exists to own it. You'll run full-cycle enterprise deals from first conversation to signed contract. You'll work directly with the CEO and the product team, because at this stage, a deal isn't just a sales process — it's a product feedback loop. You'll sell into technical buyers who already know the product, navigate complex procurement in regulated industries, and help build the playbook as you go. Plane's sales motion is product-led. The funnel doesn't start with cold outreach — it starts with teams already using Plane and hitting a ceiling where they need enterprise capabilities: compliance, SSO, air-gapped deployment, priority support. Your job is to convert that organic interest into expanding enterprise revenue. What you'll doRun deals end-to-end — from first enterprise inquiry to signed contract. You own the entire arc: discovery, demo, technical evaluation, security review, procurement, negotiation, close. Full-cycle means full ownership. Convert product-led interest into enterprise revenue — Plane's funnel doesn't start with outbound. It starts with someone self-hosting Plane, hitting a scale or compliance ceiling, and raising their hand. Your job is to recognize those signals, engage at the right moment, and guide the conversation from "we're evaluating" to "we're deploying." Navigate complex enterprise procurement — our buyers sit in aerospace, defense, healthcare, and finance. That means security questionnaires, compliance reviews, legal redlines, multi-stakeholder approval chains, and timelines measured in months, not days. You need to know how to move a deal through that machinery without losing momentum. Hold technical credibility in the room — you'll be talking to VPs of Engineering, DevOps leads, and IT architects about self-hosted deployments, air-gapped environments, SSO configurations, and data residency requirements. You don't need to be an engineer, but you need to hold your own in these conversations and know when to bring one in. Build and refine the sales playbook — document what works. Which objections come up repeatedly? What's the typical deal cycle? Where do deals stall? What collateral is missing? You're not just selling — you're creating the system that the next 3-5 AEs will run on. Feed product with deal intelligence — every deal you run generates signal about what the market wants, what competitors are doing, and where Plane has gaps. You bring that signal back to the product team in a structured, actionable way — not as a feature request list, but as a pattern. What you'll bringYou've closed enterprise software deals in the $500K–$1M ACV range, running the full cycle yourself — not inheriting qualified pipeline from a BDR team or handing off to a solutions engineer for the technical conversation.You've sold into technical buyers — engineering leadership, DevOps, IT — and you can have a real conversation about deployment models, infrastructure, and security without reading from a script. You understand the difference between selling to someone who writes codeand selling to someone who writes checks.You've worked at an early-stage company (Series A or earlier) where the sales infrastructure didn't exist yet. You've built your own pipeline, written your own sequences, created your own collateral, and figured out the motion before it was documented.You understand product-led growth and know how to work with it rather than against it. You don't fight the free tier — you see it as the top of your funnel and know how to identify when a user is ready for an enterprise conversation.You're comfortable with long deal cycles and multi-stakeholder procurement processes. You don't get rattled when a deal takes 4 months and involves legal, security, compliance, and IT all having veto power.You're structured in how you manage your pipeline, your notes, and your follow-ups. Not because someone made you use a CRM, but because you've learned that rigor is what separates someone who closes from someone who's "always about to close."You can write. Not marketing copy — clear, concise follow-up emails, proposals that address the buyer's actual concerns, and internal summaries that help the team understand what the market is telling you. Why Plane?Every company says it is different. We will try evidence instead. The scope is real. We are a passion team serving companies of every size, including some of the largest in the world. Something you ship this month will run inside a Fortune 500 company and a 50-person startup in the same week, and you will hear from both. The constraints make you better. Plane runs in our cloud, in customers' clouds, and on machines that will never touch the internet. Much of the work happens in the open, where the issues, the fixes, and the roadmap conversations are public. Building software that survives all of that is harder than building an ordinary SaaS product, and it is a better education than most companies can offer. The people-and-agents future is being built here, in production. We think humans and AI agents will share one system of action for work. We are building that system now, for customers who already depend on it, and you will work on that problem directly whatever your role. Your name is on the work. The teams are deeply connected enough that credit and responsibility both find you fast. That is some pressure. Mostly it is the fun part.If that sounds like your kind of place, we would like to meet you. Plane is an equal opportunity employer.
